newsitem.title: FRANCE: Brest air cargo traffic up 22.4 pct Jan-Sept.
newsitem.headline: Brest air cargo traffic up 22.4 pct Jan-Sept.

text.p: Brest's Guipavas airport said it handled 2,391 tonnes of global cargo traffic in the first nine months of 1996, an increase of 22.4 percent on the same period last year.

One of the main factors in the growth in traffic had been the buoyant demand for fish and seafood exports from Brittany to Paris, the south of France and Corsica, transported in the bellyholds of scheduled passenger services, an airline official at Brest Airport told Reuters.
Postal traffic was up two percent on the first nine months of last year at 1,466 tonnes, the airport authority said.
French airline L'Aeropostale carries overnight mail between its Paris-Charles-de-Gaulle hub and Brest on a regular basis using a five-tonne capacity Fokker 27 aircraft.
